row.y: 字德珪，襄阳郡襄阳县蔡州人，蔡夫人之弟。为刘表主政荆州做出了重要贡献。此后历任江夏、南郡、章陵等诸郡太守。刘表病亡后，拥护刘琮继位，并随刘琮一并降曹。小说《三国演义》中，蔡瑁和张允被设定为曹军水军都督，因周瑜反间计被杀。

supports: One global exchange-or-decline decision for the entire revealed group; no participant-by-participant choice.
Self may be selected for both skills. Discard supply is preferred; Fire Slash is given before Thunder Slash is exhausted.
Jingzhou uses current HP before damage is applied; chain prevention policies apply. Newly chained actors during later propagation do not retroactively join the original propagation set.

implementation.jingzhou: Exact BeforeDamageApplied parent/current candidate proof with pre-damage HP budget. Each frozen living role toggles through SetProgramChainedState, honoring forced/prevented chaining and draining real CharacterEnteredChain children before the next role. Completion returns to the original pending native damage. Initial elemental propagation is captured afterward; existing propagation cursors are preserved.
implementation.continuation: Only genuinely committed toggle children or an actually paid exchange continue after source loss/death. Unpaid selection/exchange choices retain normal live-source eligibility. All pending work is on ProgramSkillFrame.CaiMao; receipt collections are copied into read-only arrays. New events contain scalars or immutable scalar entity records.
implementation.zuolian: Frame-owned source/hash/current-HP target selection; targets are frozen in actual-turn action order. CommitProgramHandReveal publishes each real Hand entity and exact residency binding, naturally observed by generic reveal ledgers. One private yes/no applies to the entire group. A single native atomic batch moves every frozen pair in both directions; the shown card returns to the new card original pile, and actual gains/losses run afterward. It is neither a draw nor a discard.

inferences: The guide states two preference observations but gives no explicit cross-example for Discard Thunder versus Draw Fire. This implementation resolves zone preference first (Discard then Draw), then Fire before Thunder within that zone. This precedence is an engine inference, not a claimed FAQ.
Within the same pile and same printed Slash kind, choose a genuine remaining physical entity with deterministic seeded RNG; no player chooses or views the hidden deck inventory.

Resolve the chosen group in actual-turn action order. If there are fewer matching supply entities than selected roles, exchange the available original pairs and keep unpaired shown Hands unchanged, after one group-level yes. Newly returned Slash entities cannot become fresh supply during this same frozen exchange.

The word exchange is implemented as replacing the selected supply entity at its original draw-pile position; no top-deck placement or shuffle is stated. This positional preservation is an implementation inference. Discard replacements remain in the discard pile.

After the first committed toggle or real exchange batch has executed, native children may remove the skill/source; finish the already-issued original frozen operation once. Before commitment/payment, ordinary live-source cancellation remains in force.
